n: Teach Computing Curriculum Year 8 Thinking machines
t: A free lesson where learners train a model in Teachable Machine.
steps: Find the Teach Computing Curriculum Year 8 unit on the National Centre for Computing Education site.
Log in with a free account to download the lesson package.
Read the slides and teacher notes.
Open Google Teachable Machine and try the activity yourself.
Check that student devices have a webcam or microphone.
Ask IT to allow the Teachable Machine site.
Run the lesson with the class.
